name: Unity MCP
description: Work in your open Unity project through the MCP for Unity server on this Mac.

disclosure: Tasks you connect can inspect and change the scenes, assets, scripts, packages and builds of the Unity project connected to MCP for Unity.
Octopus talks to the MCP for Unity server at 127.0.0.1:8080 on this Mac and keeps no sign-in for it.
Open your project in Unity with MCP for Unity set to HTTP Local: it starts that server and connects the Editor. Window › MCP for Unity shows both.
